final: WITH per AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_pts, COUNT(*) AS field FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), ov AS (SELECT AVG(field) AS avg_field FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.avg_pts) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(per.field) AS avg_field_size, AVG(per.field - ov.avg_field) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM per, ov WHERE per.field > ov.avg_field
